caveats.resolution: Each retry was preceded by on-chain score-status readback. All fifteen final scores matched the exact official team/time result before settlement.

caveats.chainEffect: Five per-game configurations used a disclosed overround below the requested 300 bps.
caveats.observation: The reviewed market-maker feasibility guard declined configurations that would widen beyond thinner live upstream/reference odds overrounds.
caveats.resolution: Only per-game configuration changed; reviewed source remained unchanged. Effective values were recorded for every contest.

caveats.observation: Kansas City at Detroit finished 5–4 against total 9.0.

caveats.observation: One planning record copied an obsolete CLI digest even though the unchanged reviewed binary was used.
caveats.resolution: The actual binary digest 8037b56d… was recomputed, matched every seeded checkpoint and the reviewed source commit, and was frozen before postgame writes.

caveats.resolution: Useful transcript observations were incorporated, then the finalizer passed live identity, on-chain score-status, wrong-time rejection, role/contract/chain binding, teardown-guard, lint, compile, and hash-freeze checks. This is not represented as independent approval.
